digest.component_or_area: agent documentation and tracker access workflows
propositions: ChatGPT sessions may lack tracker-worktree access, direct Gerrit/shell connectivity, or a local clone while retaining GitHub connector read access; existing guidance does not cover safe operations in this constrained environment.

Native ticket creation is impossible only when both tracker-worktree-and-(network-or-native-binary) dimensions fail; all other capability-loss combinations permit fallback payload generation or existing operations to continue.

Fallback ticket payloads must conform to export.schema.json's actual required fields (schema_version, ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status) plus description and parent_id, with ticket_id as an agent-generated UUID4 that becomes source_id on import, enabling idempotent re-import without duplication.

rebar import is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path; it accepts NDJSON (not raw events), assigns fresh local ids/HLC timestamps, and silently skips (with no warning or counter increment in --dry-run mode) records missing ticket_id/ticket_type, detectable via would_create + skipped != total records.

Guidance must prohibit hand-authored event mutations, GitHub-Issues substitution, and direct Contents-API writes to tickets branch, while requiring search-before-create, tracker-worktree verification, and post-import validation (rebar validate/fsck) to preserve append-only and optimistic-concurrency invariants.
